text: Between 1933 and 1935, Jewish organizations initiated a trial in Bern against members of the Swiss extreme right-wing National Front who had distributed The Protocols of the Elders of Zion. The plaintiffs won. In May 1935 the trial judge ruled that the text was plagiarised and a fabrication.
meta_description: The Protocols of the Elders of Zion: Jewish organizations brought a Bern trial in 1933-1935; in May 1935 the judge ruled the text plagiarised and a fabrication.
